1. Zara — Ground, Central Zone. They have a wide range of stylish jackets, and right now they’re running their End of Season Sale with up to 50% off.
2. Nike — First, North Wing. Perfect if you want sporty or casual jackets, plus they offer shoe customization if you’re interested.
3. H&M — Ground, West Wing. Good for trendy and affordable jacket options for men and women.
4. Mango — First, East Wing. Offers chic and modern jacket styles, great for a polished look.
